description: This file declares the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages lifecycle state transitions, state creation, validation, and event notifications for a plugin component. It includes method declarations for changing states, creating states, validating transitions, updating states, sending events, and retrieving state paths, along with static member variables for tracking state transitions and state strings.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: Manages lifecycle state transitions, creation, validation, and event notifications within the plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, setting up necessary state transition data.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the lifecycle state based on a request, returning success or failure and an error reason.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new State object based on the application context and target lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from a start state to a target state is valid within the allowed transition paths.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the application context to a new lifecycle state.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a lifecycle state change event with old and new states.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Retrieves the path of states leading to a specified lifecycle state.
